methodology: Generated fixtures only, in one fresh child process. Full-height 4x3 main chunks exclude one chest/inventory cell and add one disconnected cell 512 blocks away; the selected total is unchanged. Only required destination lighting neighborhoods exist; intervening terrain is absent. Source contains mixed building blocks, three intentional air variants, exact stair properties and opaque NBT. Capture includes automatic archive validation. Preview includes safety gates and typed preflight. Export includes fresh preview, verified backup/working copies, repeated validation, bounded chunk/region rewrite, full file verification and atomic publication. Independent verification compares every selected and excluded cell in all destination chunks, preserved typed metadata, archive raw terrain bytes, and all original/backup file hashes. maxRSS is the OS process peak in KiB reported by Node, divided by 1024 for MiB; it includes fixture generation, all measured stages and independent verification, with no forced GC. The fixture is deliberately repetitive; compression ratio is not representative of every real build. No Minecraft game-load test, UI test or cancellation benchmark is included. Temporary fixture worlds, template, backup and result copy are deleted after measurement.
